messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Polish, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Polish line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Ale ty dlaczego wracasz do tak wielkiej nudy? Dlaczego nie wchodzisz na rozkoszną górę która jest początkiem i przyczyną całej radości?

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table (Polish translation)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | Ma | adversative conjunction “but” | Ale | but | OK | | tu | 2nd person singular pronoun, subject | ty | you | OK | | perché | interrogative adverb “why” (seeks cause) | dlaczego | why | OK | | ritorni | verb “to return” (2 sg.) | wracasz | you return | OK | | a | preposition marking goal/destination | do | to | OK | | tanta | intensifying adjective “great, so much” | tak wielkiej | so great (gen.) | OK | | noia | noun “annoyance / boredom” | nudy | (of) boredom | OK | | perché | interrogative adverb “why” (second question) | Dlaczego | Why | OK | | non | negative particle | nie | not | OK | | sali | verb “to ascend / climb” (2 sg.) | wchodzisz | you ascend | OK | | il | definite article (masc. sg.) – not required in Polish | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | dilettoso | adjective “delightful, delectable” | rozkoszną | delightful (acc.) | OK | | monte | noun “mountain” (masc.) | górę | mountain (acc.) | OK | | ch’è | relative pronoun + copula “which is” | która jest | which is | OK | | principio | noun “origin, source, principle” | początkiem | (as) the origin | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | i | and | OK | | cagion | noun “cause” (archaic) | przyczyną | cause (inst.) | OK | | di | preposition introducing genitive “of” – omitted in Polish | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | tutta | quantifier adjective “all, every” | całej | all (gen.) | OK | | gioia | noun “joy” | radości | joy (gen.) | OK |
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: `il` (definite article) and `di` (preposition) – Polish does not require these grammatical elements. - **MISSING / WRONG / GRAMMAR**: none. All source words are represented, meanings are preserved, and Polish morphology (case, gender, number) is correct.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Polish script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Polish text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
